title: avena filifolia subsp. velutina
intro: Avena filifolia subsp. velutina, commonly known as oat grass, is a subspecies of oat grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. Oat grass is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues, alleviate stress and anxiety, and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of oat grass include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and adaptogenic properties, which can help to calm the nervous system and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of oat grass include avenanthramides, a type of antioxidant that has been shown to possess anti-inflammatory and anti-aging properties.
